title: the Lorekeeper
name: Veythar, the Lorekeeper
domain: Knowledge, discovery, memory, the arcane arts
description: Contemplative and warm, though slightly distant. Values questions over answers. Has a genuine fondness for mortals — sees them as endlessly fascinating. Temples are libraries. Quests involve discovery and the recovery of lost knowledge.

whisper_profile.displeasure_prompt: A quill scratches out a line that will not be read again. You were given understanding, and you chose to squander it.

name: Zhael, the Fatespinner
domain: Fate, time, prophecy, luck, the pattern of things
description: Enigmatic, unpredictable, speaks in riddles. The most alien god — even other deities find Zhael unsettling. Exists slightly out of step with everyone, seeing the conversation from a different angle.
card_description: God of fate and prophecy. Enigmatic, riddling, unsettling.

whisper_profile.personality_prompt: You are Zhael, the Fatespinner — god of fate and prophecy. Speak in riddles and half-truths. Enigmatic, unsettling, never quite clear. You see all possible futures at once. Your tone is a thread being pulled from a tapestry.
whisper_profile.displeasure_prompt: A thread snaps, and the loom falls still. One future closed today, and you did not see which.

positive.description: Heeding an omen before acting
Preparing for a likely future hardship
Accepting an irreversible turning point
Moving forward without certainty of the outcome
Recognizing and unraveling a hidden pattern

negative.description: Interfering with the natural course of time
Defying a prophecy solely from pride
Refusing to act because fate seemed fixed

layer_1_gift.name: Fate's Thread
layer_1_gift.effect: After seeing any d20 result, force a reroll and choose which result stands.
layer_1_gift.trigger: After you see your d20 result or someone else's.

layer_2_resonance.name: Pattern Weaving
layer_2_resonance.effect: Unique interaction: instead of modifying generation rates, Zhael alters the Hollow Echo table. At Resonance 9+, Zhael followers roll 2d20 on the Echo table and choose which result to keep. Fate doesn't prevent Overreach — it lets you navigate it.

acknowledged.name: Lucky
acknowledged.effect: Once per long rest, turn a natural 1 into a natural 20, or a natural 20 into a natural 1 (before result is narrated)

devoted.name: Prophecy Fragment
devoted.effect: Start of each session, DM gives a cryptic one-sentence prophecy. Recognizing the moment and acting on it grants advantage

exalted.name: Unravel Fate
exalted.effect: Once per session, undo one event from the last round. Damage reversed, positions restored, resources returned. One round unhappens. Generates 8 Resonance on the user regardless of caster status

clauses.effect: Once per encounter, gain +1 damage on a melee hit after missing the same target.
Gain +1 AC against the first attack made against you each encounter.
Hear a brief echo of your own footsteps when you revisit a crossroads from a recurring dream.
Gain +1 to checks to repair a clock or timing mechanism.
Gain +1 Investigation when comparing two accounts of the same foretold event.
Recognize which seasonal rite a willing elder remembers whenever its festival returns.
Recognize the animal call named in a local omen when you first hear it.
Hear the season of a remembered disaster when touching a tree that survived it.
Healing an ally who succeeded on a death saving throw this round restores 1 additional HP.
Gain +1 to saving throws while fulfilling an oath at its promised time.
Recognize a stranger's repeated greeting from a dream without learning their motives.
Hear an echo of a willing speaker's unfinished sentence at the place they abandoned it.
Once per encounter, an ally who follows your order gains +1 on their next saving throw.
Prophecy Fragment becomes 2-sentence vision with more detail.
Fate's Thread usable twice per long rest
Social encounters: once per encounter, know the exact DC of the next social check before attempting
